description.value: The Nelson & District Community Complex is a publicly operated recreation facility managed by the Regional District of Central Kootenay, serving Nelson and surrounding communities. OSM identifies it as a sports centre with an ice hockey focus, suggesting it includes arena ice surfaces alongside other community recreation amenities. Touring cyclists passing through Nelson would find it listed among the RDCK's network of regional community complexes.
